prompt.project_info: Ultra-photorealistic candid couple moment in the shallow water of a Mugla-style cove.
prompt.main_subject: Two approved adults in waist-deep water, ordinary natural faces, laughing softly and leaning closer; woman in a simple dark swimsuit with wet hair and man in simple swim shorts, both without logos.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 medium handheld shoreline shot, couple slightly off-center, faces sharp, one partner splashing lightly while the other laughs, turquoise waterline, pine hills and rocks behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural sun and sky fill, realistic wet hair and water sheen, controlled highlights, playful romantic documentary atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm equivalent candid photography, subtle 35mm grain, crisp natural detail, realistic ripples and splash motion, no HDR or artificial glow.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 9:16 ultra-photorealistic candid travel photograph of two approved adults standing waist-deep in shallow turquoise water in a Mugla-style pine cove, laughing softly as one splashes lightly and they lean closer, woman in a simple dark swimsuit with wet hair and man in simple swim shorts, rocky pine hills behind, natural sun and sky fill, handheld 35mm documentary feel, no logos or luxury elements.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed faces, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR, AI glow, fake water, watermark, logo overlay

assets.name: mugla-shallow-water-romance.jpg
assets.usage: Match both approved adults, laugh, splash, swimwear, water, pine hills, composition and natural light.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve both adult identities, faces, hair, pose, swimwear, cove, composition and lighting. Swimwear and water details are replaceable; keep the interaction non-explicit and avoid celebrity likeness or overlay text.
